candidate.blueprint_locator: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies, printed p.12: identify contraindications/interactions, administer medications safely, and provide medication teaching.
candidate.blueprint_topic: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies — nitrate/PDE-5 inhibitor interaction
candidate.educational_objective: Recognize the contraindicated interaction between sublingual nitroglycerin and PDE-5 inhibitors such as sildenafil because of severe hypotension risk.

options.A: Do not use sublingual nitroglycerin while taking a PDE-5 inhibitor such as sildenafil because the combination can cause severe hypotension, syncope, or myocardial ischemia.
options.B: Take an extra nitroglycerin dose with sildenafil because PDE-5 inhibitors reduce nitrate effectiveness.
options.C: Use the combination only while standing because an upright position prevents clinically important hypotension.
options.D: Separate sildenafil and nitroglycerin by one hour because this interval eliminates the labeled interaction for all patients.

candidate.rationale: Current nitroglycerin sublingual-tablet labeling contraindicates use in patients taking PDE-5 inhibitors including sildenafil, tadalafil, vardenafil, and avanafil. Concomitant use can cause severe hypotension, syncope, or myocardial ischemia. A is correct; the label does not establish a universal one-hour interval that makes the combination safe.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Sublingual nitroglycerin is contraindicated with PDE-5 inhibitors such as sildenafil because the combination can cause severe hypotension, syncope, or myocardial ischemia.
candidate.source_locator: §4.1 PDE-5 Inhibitors and sGC Stimulators: do not use nitroglycerin in patients taking PDE-5 inhibitors such as sildenafil, tadalafil, vardenafil, or avanafil; concomitant use can cause severe hypotension, syncope, or myocardial ischemia.
candidate.source_organization: DailyMed / U.S. National Library of Medicine official drug label
candidate.stem: A client who uses sublingual nitroglycerin for angina reports taking sildenafil. Which teaching is most important?
